Theorem
[Tensor maximum principle, third version] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0114, chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0115 1. Theorem 4.9\group advanced-weak-maximum-principles-systems

With the same setup, allow $\mathcal K(t)\subset \mathcal E$ to vary with time. If $\alpha (0)\in \mathcal K(0)$, the space-time track $\bigcup _{t\in [0,T]}(\mathcal K(t)\times \{ t\} )$ is closed in $\mathcal E\times [0,T]$, each $\mathcal K(t)$ is invariant under parallel translation by $\bar\nabla (t)$, each fiber slice $\mathcal K_x(t)$ is closed and convex, and every fiberwise ODE solution starting in $\mathcal K_x(0)$ remains in $\mathcal K_x(t)$, then $\alpha (t)\in \mathcal K(t)$ for all $t\in [0,T]$.
